headline: Olenox Industries expands energy-powered digital infrastructure
summary: Olenox Industries reported its latest bitcoin production metrics as recent acquisitions expanded its integrated energy infrastructure strategy.
why: Cryptocurrency miners tied directly to dedicated energy assets attempt to mitigate power cost volatility inherent in digital asset production.

impacts.name: Olenox Industries
impacts.why: Expanding integrated energy infrastructure strategies helps mitigate power cost volatility for digital asset production.
